intro_md: Scrolls apply enchantments to eligible weapons and fishing rods. Higher tiers support more enchantment levels and may introduce blessing or curse rolls, while two special scrolls remain admin-only.
description_md:
## Choose a tier for the item

Common, Rare, Legendary, and Mythical Scrolls are the player-obtainable progression. Their Enchant levels field shows the maximum level budget, while Recipe and Source show how to get each tier.

## Understand special rolls

Legendary and Mythical tiers can produce special blessing or curse results. The Special roll field records that behavior, so compare it before spending rare materials.

## Keep admin scrolls separate

Blessed and Cursed Scrolls are documented system entries but are unavailable to normal players. They remain in their own section so the collection explains the full named scroll set without presenting admin tools as progression targets.
how_it_works_md: Tier and Enchant levels describe scroll strength. Recipe and Source explain obtainment, Availability separates player routes from admin-only rows, and Special roll records blessing or curse behavior.

faq_json.q: Can normal players get Blessed or Cursed Scrolls?

faq_json.q: Why do some scroll rows have no image?
faq_json.a: Common, Rare, and Mythical lack exact source art in the verified local set, so they stay text-first instead of using proxy images.
